summary: Defines a DHCPv6 option that tells a client the longest time it should wait before asking again for configuration information. It is meant for stateless DHCPv6, where no leases exist to tell the client when to refresh. This standards-track document was later replaced by RFC 8415.

eli5.summary: A reminder note on a fridge saying check again for updates after this long. Without it, a device that gets settings once might never ask again.

questions: how often should dhcpv6 clients refresh
